title: Slovakian Stew with Fenugreek
description: A hearty Slovakian-inspired stew made with tender jagged potatoes, gooey fenugreek sauce, and a hint of traditional Slovakian spices.

ingredients.name: Slovakian Spices
ingredients.notes: A mix of paprika, caraway seeds, and garlic powder

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion, carrot, and celery, and sauté until tender.
Add jagged potatoes, Slovakian spices, and fenugreek sauce. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
